formula: effective(r,t) = drift_priority(r) + R * max(0, t - release_r) / H; highest effective priority first; ties by request_order_key
selection_criterion: largest H (weakest age escalation) among k*tau, k in (1,2,4,8,16), such that on the training workload (a) no request waits more than 60 s (unfinished requests counted at their observed age) and (b) p99 request wait <= 1.25 x consecutive-pair; if none qualifies the smallest H is used and the configuration is PROVISIONAL
calibration_data: training partition only: 14509 requests released before the holdout boundary 21920.355064249998
overtake_bound: a request can only be overtaken by requests released at most H seconds after it (conditional bound; not a maximum-wait guarantee)
